'''Ben Saraf''' ({{langx|he|בן שרף}}; born April 14, 2006) is an Israeli professional [[basketball]] player for [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).

==Professional career==
Saraf began his professional career at 16 years old while playing for [[Elitzur Netanya B.C.|Elitzur Netanya]] of the second-division [[Israeli Basketball National League]]. He averaged 14 points, 3.3 rebounds, and 3 assists during the [[2022–23 Israeli Basketball National League|2022–23 season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ynet.co.il/sport/article/sydpi2b8c|title=התקווה הישראלית בדראפט 2026 :תוכן גולשים|first=Ziv|last=Narkis|website=[[Ynet.com]]|date=June 25, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024|language=Hebrew}}</ref>

Saraf signed with [[Elitzur Kiryat Ata]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]] on July 11, 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport5.co.il/articles.aspx?FolderID=274&docID=442593|title=עולה לליגת העל: בן שרף חתם בקריית אתא|first=Noa|last=Poplinger|website=[[Sports Channel (Israel)|Sports Channel]]|date=July 11, 2023|access-date=September 18, 2024|language=Hebrew}}</ref> He was named the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League Rising Star|Israeli League Premier Rising Star]] after averaging 10.7 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.7 assists, and 1.0 steals per game.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/with-ratiopharm-ulm-ben-saraf-is-in-the-perfect-environment|title=With Ratiopharm Ulm, Ben Saraf Is in the Perfect Environment|first=Andrew|last=Bernucca|website=[[SI.com]]|date=September 17, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport5.co.il/articles.aspx?FolderID=274&docID=471656|title=בן שרף נבחר לתגלית העונה, גיא פלטין שחקן ההגנה|website=[[Sports Channel (Israel)|Sports Channel]]|date=May 30, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024|language=Hebrew}}</ref>

Saraf signed with [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL) on June 20, 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/eurocup/news/ulm-invests-in-teenage-sensation-ben-saraf/|title=Ulm invests in teenage sensation Ben Saraf|website=EuroleagueBasketball.net|date=June 20, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}}</ref>

==National team career==
Saraf played for the [[Israel men's national under-16 basketball team|Israel under-16 basketball team]] in the [[2022 FIBA U16 European Championship]]. He led the tournament in scoring with 24.3 points per game.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-812442|title=Ben Saraf takes leadership role for blue-and-white at U18 Euros|first=Joshua|last=Halickman|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=July 30, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}}</ref> Saraf was named to the [[Israel men's national under-18 basketball team|under-18 national team]] to compete in the [[2024 FIBA U18 EuroBasket]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/sports/article-815523|title=Israel's youth basketball team has successful run|first=Joshua|last=Halickman|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=August 20, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}}</ref> He again led the tournament in scoring with 28.1 points per game and was named the tournament MVP as Israel finished fourth.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ynetnews.com/culture/article/rj49wyu9a|title=Israeli basketball player Ben Saraf is poised to reach the NBA|website=[[Ynet.com]]|date=August 13, 2024|access-date=September 18, 2024}}</ref>
